rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the sport and for literal feats of physical agility.

example.english: The kids go to gymnastics class every week.
example.traditional: 小朋友每個星期都去學體操。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 heoi3 hok6 tai2 cou1

rows.note: Use this for the figurative intellectual or artistic-exercise sense of “mental gymnastics,” rather than the physical sport.

example.english: This math problem really takes some mental gymnastics to figure out.
example.traditional: 呢條數學題真係要做下腦筋體操先諗到。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 zan1 hai6 jiu3 zou6 haa5 nou5 gan1 tai2 cou1 sin1 nam2 dou3
